text:
You have a suppression rule in Microsoft Defender for Cloud for 10 virtual machines that are used for testing. The virtual machines run Windows Server.
You are troubleshooting an issue on the virtual machines.
In Microsoft Defender for Cloud, you need to view the alerts generated by the virtual machines during the last five days.
What should you do?

choices.text: Change the rule expiration date of the suppression rule.
Change the state of the suppression rule to Disabled.
Modify the filter for the Security alerts page.
View the Windows event logs on the virtual machines.

text:
You have an Azure Storage account that will be accessed by multiple Azure Functions apps during the development of an application.
You need to hide Microsoft Defender for Cloud alerts for the storage account.
Which entity type and field should you use in a suppression rule? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.
Note: Each correct selection is worth one point.
Hot Area:

A SOC wants new high-severity Microsoft Sentinel incidents to be assigned to the Tier 2 queue and moved to a consistent status before any external response workflow runs. Which TWO actions can an automation rule handle directly as part of incident management?

choices.text: Assign the incident to a designated owner
Change the incident status when conditions match
Query an external threat-intelligence API for enrichment
Run a forensic PowerShell script on the affected endpoint
Create a memory image from the affected device

text: An analyst needs Microsoft Sentinel to open a ticket in an external service-management platform and then post investigation details to a collaboration channel whenever a qualifying incident is created. What should the analyst build for this cross-service workflow?

An organization wants Defender for Endpoint remediation actions on standard user devices to run automatically, while actions on a sensitive server group should require security-team approval. Which configuration provides that control?

choices.text: Set different automation levels on Defender for Endpoint device groups
Create separate Microsoft Sentinel workbooks for the device categories
Use different Microsoft Purview audit-retention policies by device type
Apply different Microsoft Sentinel hunting queries to each device category

text: A security engineer is configuring the Windows Security Events via AMA connector for Microsoft Sentinel and needs to control which Windows event-log records are collected and where they are sent. Which object should be configured?

A Microsoft Sentinel detection must evaluate newly ingested events with the lowest built-in rule latency because a one-minute delay materially affects containment. Which analytics rule type best fits this requirement?

choices.text: A scheduled analytics rule with a daily interval
A workbook query pinned to the SOC dashboard

text: A threat hunter has a validated Advanced Hunting query in Microsoft Defender XDR and wants the query to run automatically, generate alerts when it matches, and optionally take response actions. What should be created?

A team keeps large volumes of security telemetry in the Microsoft Sentinel data lake tier. It wants a scheduled KQL process to query that data and place selected results into the analytics tier for faster downstream use. Which feature should it configure?

A built-in Microsoft Sentinel analytics rule queries the SecurityEvent table, but events arriving through a Windows Forwarded Events connector never match the rule even though forwarding is healthy. What is the most likely explanation?

choices.text: Forwarded events are written to WindowsEvent instead of SecurityEvent
The connector stores forwarded events only in Defender XDR incidents
Windows Event Forwarding suppresses all events used by analytics rules
The SecurityEvent table accepts only events collected from Linux hosts

text: An analyst is investigating suspicious behavior on one endpoint and needs a chronological view of observed events, associated alerts, process relationships, and MITRE ATT&CK techniques for that device. Which Defender for Endpoint view should be opened first?

A security analyst must connect to a compromised endpoint immediately, run investigative commands, collect forensic artifacts, and take remediation actions without waiting for an interactive user session. Which capability is designed for this?

During an endpoint investigation, the SOC wants a downloadable package that captures information about the device state so analysts can examine evidence outside the live portal session. Which Defender for Endpoint response action best matches this need?

An investigation asks who changed a Microsoft 365 administrative setting and when the change occurred. The analyst needs a record of user and administrator activity rather than the content of messages or files. Which tool is the best starting point?

A phishing investigation needs to locate messages and related files containing a distinctive campaign phrase across Exchange mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint sites. Which Microsoft Purview capability best fits this evidence search?

A SOC is investigating a suspected pass-the-ticket attack against on-premises Active Directory accounts and wants identity-focused detections for lateral movement techniques. Which Microsoft security product is most directly aligned to this investigation?

Microsoft Defender XDR confirms an active attack involving a compromised endpoint and a compromised user account. Which TWO automated disruption actions are designed to directly interrupt those attacker footholds?

choices.text: Isolate the compromised device from most network traffic
Disable the compromised user to prevent further sign-in
Collect an investigation package from the endpoint
Export the incident to a workbook for visualization
Search Microsoft Purview Audit for administrator activity

text: A hunter wants to query Microsoft Defender XDR telemetry specifically for process creation and related process events observed on onboarded endpoints. Which Advanced Hunting table is the best starting point?
